import pandas as pd

import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert 'date' to datetime
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# Aggregate sales by date
daily_sales = df.groupby('date')['total'].sum().reset_index()

# Create a plot
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 7))

plt.title('Daily Total Sales at Coffee Shop', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Date', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert 'date' to datetime
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# Aggregate sales by date
daily_sales = df.groupby('date')['total'].sum().reset_index()

# Create a plot
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 7))
sns.lineplot(data=daily_sales, x='date', y='total', marker='o', color='mediumseagreen')

# Customize the plot
plt.title('Daily Total Sales at Coffee Shop', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Date', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
